description.value:
“Your body is built for a world that bites back. So is your patience.”

Wildframe. Add your tier [TODO(pb-call)] to Body check made to resist Stress.

Keen Sense. Choose one at character creation: Keen Smell, Keen Hearing, or Keen Sight. You have reroll the lowest die on Soul (Perception (Mind) (Mind) (Mind)) checks [TODO(adv-call)] that rely on that sense.

Frame Choice. Choose one narrative frame at character creation; it is permanent.

  • Predator. Your unarmed strikes (bite or claws) deal 1d6 instead of 1d4 and count as natural weapons.
  • Forager. You gain a skill rank in the Athletics (Violence) (Violence) (Body) skill. If you already have it, you may choose another skill from the Cryptidkin list (GM adjudicates).
  • Brute. You count as one size larger for the purposes of carrying capacity, push, drag, lift, shove, and grapple.
